related: Toolbar — the list-page filter strip (alias FilterBar); it wraps, so filters go there rather than in a CardBar.
tagline: Inline card toolbar with scoped inset and divider edges.
usage: Compose inside Card. Unset border follows its position; explicit border prevents double rules in stacked bars.

DON'T put list filters (search, filter selects, filter chips) in a CardBar: its main slot scrolls sideways when crowded, and a filter strip wraps (cardinal rule #51). Filters are a Toolbar/FilterBar above the card.
useCases: Composer tool strips and view tabs.
